title: Forgotten Password
description: Northstar's identity service contains a flawed password-reset workflow. Investigate the recovery API, identify the administrator account, reconstruct the predictable reset token, and recover the flag.
hints: The browser is only the frontend. Look at the API calls it makes.
Password recovery has more than one endpoint. Examine what the identity service tells you about an account.
The reset timestamp is more useful than it first appears.
